anomalies.description: Unit GX-350 (acquisition<2023) terdegradasi efisiensi sejak Mei 2025
anomalies.verification_sql:
-- A01: unit GX-350 (acquisition < 2023-01-01) degradasi efisiensi mulai Mei 2025
-- target: km/l turun ~16.7% (8.4 -> ~7.0) pada H2 dibanding sebelum Mei
WITH consumption AS (
  SELECT ft.vehicle_id, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ft.transacted_at)::int AS month,
         ft.liters, LAG(ft.odometer_km) OVER (PARTITION BY ft.vehicle_id ORDER BY ft.transacted_at) AS prev_odo,
         ft.odometer_km
  FROM fleet.fuel_transactions ft
  JOIN fleet.vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id = ft.vehicle_id
  JOIN fleet.vehicle_models vm ON vm.model_id = v.model_id
  WHERE vm.model_code = 'GX-350' AND v.acquisition_date < '2023-01-01'
),
kpl AS (
  SELECT month, (odometer_km - prev_odo)::numeric / NULLIF(liters,0) AS km_per_liter
  FROM consumption WHERE prev_odo IS NOT NULL AND odometer_km > prev_odo
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(km_per_liter) FILTER (WHERE month < 5), 2) AS kpl_before_may,
  ROUND(AVG(km_per_liter) FILTER (WHERE month >= 5), 2) AS kpl_from_may,
  ROUND((1 - AVG(km_per_liter) FILTER (WHERE month >= 5) / NULLIF(AVG(km_per_liter) FILTER (WHERE month < 5),0)) * 100, 1) AS pct_drop,
  CASE WHEN AVG(km_per_liter) FILTER (WHERE month >= 5) < AVG(km_per_liter) FILTER (WHERE month < 5) * 0.92
       THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status
FROM kpl;

anomalies.description: Koridor Cakung<->Tanjung Priok macet mulai Agustus (delay aditif)
anomalies.verification_sql:
-- A02: koridor Cakung/Tanjung Priok macet mulai Agustus (delay aditif -> naik transit_hours)
WITH d AS (
  SELECT dl.delivery_id, dl.dispatched_at, dl.delivered_at,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (dl.delivered_at - dl.dispatched_at))/3600.0 AS transit_h,
         lo.location_code AS origin_code
  FROM fleet.deliveries dl
  JOIN fleet.orders o ON o.order_id = dl.order_id
  JOIN fleet.locations lo ON lo.location_id = o.origin_location_id
  WHERE dl.status = 'delivered' AND dl.delivered_at > dl.dispatched_at
    AND lo.location_code IN ('JKT-01','JKT-02')
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(transit_h) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM dispatched_at) = 7), 2) AS avg_transit_jul,
  ROUND(AVG(transit_h) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM dispatched_at) = 8), 2) AS avg_transit_aug,
  ROUND((AVG(transit_h) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM dispatched_at) = 8) /
         NULLIF(AVG(transit_h) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM dispatched_at) = 7),0) - 1) * 100, 1) AS pct_increase,
  CASE WHEN AVG(transit_h) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM dispatched_at) = 8) >
            AVG(transit_h) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM dispatched_at) = 7) * 1.15
       THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status
FROM d;

anomalies.description: Kendaraan overdue service -> breakdown rate jauh lebih tinggi
anomalies.verification_sql:
-- A03: kendaraan overdue service (odometer - last_service > interval*1.25) -> breakdown rate lebih tinggi
WITH veh_status AS (
  SELECT vehicle_id,
         (odometer_km - last_service_odometer_km) > (service_interval_km * 1.25) AS is_overdue
  FROM fleet.vehicles
),
breakdown_count AS (
  SELECT ve.vehicle_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ve.ev_type = 'breakdown') AS n_breakdown, COUNT(*) AS n_events
  FROM fleet.vehicle_events ve GROUP BY ve.vehicle_id
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(bc.n_breakdown) FILTER (WHERE vs.is_overdue), 3) AS avg_breakdown_overdue,
  ROUND(AVG(bc.n_breakdown) FILTER (WHERE NOT vs.is_overdue), 3) AS avg_breakdown_normal,
  ROUND(AVG(bc.n_breakdown) FILTER (WHERE vs.is_overdue) / NULLIF(AVG(bc.n_breakdown) FILTER (WHERE NOT vs.is_overdue),0), 2) AS ratio,
  CASE WHEN AVG(bc.n_breakdown) FILTER (WHERE vs.is_overdue) >
            AVG(bc.n_breakdown) FILTER (WHERE NOT vs.is_overdue) * 2.0
       THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status
FROM veh_status vs LEFT JOIN breakdown_count bc ON bc.vehicle_id = vs.vehicle_id;

anomalies.description: 41 driver lisensi B2 ditugaskan ke tronton/tractor_head -> failure & harsh_braking naik
anomalies.verification_sql:
-- A04: driver B2 (bukan B2_UMUM) yang dipakai berulang di kendaraan tronton/tractor_head
-- -> failure rate & harsh_braking rate lebih tinggi
WITH heavy AS (
  SELECT dl.delivery_id, dl.driver_id, dl.status, dl.vehicle_id, dr.license_type
  FROM fleet.deliveries dl
  JOIN fleet.vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id = dl.vehicle_id
  JOIN fleet.vehicle_models vm ON vm.model_id = v.model_id
  JOIN fleet.drivers dr ON dr.driver_id = dl.driver_id
  WHERE vm.v_class IN ('tronton','tractor_head')
),
mismatch_drivers AS (
  -- driver B2 (bukan B2_UMUM) dengan >=15 delivery kendaraan berat -> pola mismatch sistematis
  SELECT driver_id FROM heavy WHERE license_type = 'B2'
  GROUP BY driver_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15
),
tagged AS (
  SELECT h.*, (h.driver_id IN (SELECT driver_id FROM mismatch_drivers)) AS is_mismatch
  FROM heavy h
),
hb AS (
  SELECT delivery_id, COUNT(*) AS n_hb FROM fleet.vehicle_events
  WHERE ev_type = 'harsh_braking' AND delivery_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY delivery_id
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT driver_id) FILTER (WHERE is_mismatch) AS n_mismatch_drivers,
  ROUND(AVG((status IN ('failed','returned'))::int) FILTER (WHERE is_mismatch), 4) AS fail_rate_mismatch,
  ROUND(AVG((status IN ('failed','returned'))::int) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_mismatch), 4) AS fail_rate_baseline,
  ROUND(AVG((status IN ('failed','returned'))::int) FILTER (WHERE is_mismatch) /
        NULLIF(AVG((status IN ('failed','returned'))::int) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_mismatch),0), 2) AS fail_ratio,
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(hb.n_hb,0)::numeric) FILTER (WHERE is_mismatch), 4) AS hb_rate_mismatch,
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(hb.n_hb,0)::numeric) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_mismatch), 4) AS hb_rate_baseline,
  CASE WHEN
    AVG((status IN ('failed','returned'))::int) FILTER (WHERE is_mismatch) >
    AVG((status IN ('failed','returned'))::int) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_mismatch) * 2.0
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT driver_id) FILTER (WHERE is_mismatch) BETWEEN 20 AND 60
  THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status
FROM tagged t LEFT JOIN hb ON hb.delivery_id = t.delivery_id;

anomalies.description: DEFINITION OF DONE: DKI operational cost naik Agustus, 3 penyebab, volume red herring negatif
anomalies.verification_sql:
-- A05: skenario Definition of Done -- DKI operational cost naik Agustus, 3 penyebab, volume TURUN (red herring)
WITH dki_deliv AS (
  SELECT dl.*, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM dl.dispatched_at)::int AS month
  FROM fleet.deliveries dl
  JOIN fleet.orders o ON o.order_id = dl.order_id
  JOIN fleet.locations ld ON ld.location_id = o.destination_location_id
  JOIN fleet.regions r ON r.region_id = ld.region_id
  WHERE r.region_code = 'DKI'
),
dki_mtc AS (
  SELECT m.*, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m.scheduled_date)::int AS month
  FROM fleet.maintenance m
  JOIN fleet.locations w ON w.location_id = m.workshop_location_id
  JOIN fleet.regions r ON r.region_id = w.region_id
  WHERE r.region_code = 'DKI' AND m.mtc_type = 'corrective'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(delivery_cost_idr) FILTER (WHERE month=7) AS delivery_jul,
    SUM(delivery_cost_idr) FILTER (WHERE month=8) AS delivery_aug,
    SUM(fuel_cost_idr) FILTER (WHERE month=7) AS fuel_jul, SUM(fuel_cost_idr) FILTER (WHERE month=8) AS fuel_aug,
    SUM(overtime_cost_idr) FILTER (WHERE month=7) AS ot_jul, SUM(overtime_cost_idr) FILTER (WHERE month=8) AS ot_aug,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE month=7) AS vol_jul, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE month=8) AS vol_aug
  FROM dki_deliv
),
magg AS (
  SELECT SUM(cost_idr) FILTER (WHERE month=7) AS mtc_jul, SUM(cost_idr) FILTER (WHERE month=8) AS mtc_aug
  FROM dki_mtc
)
SELECT
  (agg.delivery_jul + magg.mtc_jul) AS op_cost_jul,
  (agg.delivery_aug + magg.mtc_aug) AS op_cost_aug,
  ROUND((((agg.delivery_aug+magg.mtc_aug)::numeric/(agg.delivery_jul+magg.mtc_jul)) - 1)*100,1) AS mom_pct,
  ROUND(((agg.fuel_aug::numeric/agg.fuel_jul)-1)*100,1) AS fuel_pct_change,
  ROUND(((agg.ot_aug::numeric/NULLIF(agg.ot_jul,0))-1)*100,1) AS overtime_pct_change,
  ROUND(((magg.mtc_aug::numeric/magg.mtc_jul)-1)*100,1) AS maintenance_pct_change,
  ROUND(((agg.vol_aug::numeric/agg.vol_jul)-1)*100,1) AS volume_pct_change,
  CASE WHEN (agg.delivery_aug+magg.mtc_aug) > (agg.delivery_jul+magg.mtc_jul)   -- operational cost naik
        AND agg.fuel_aug > agg.fuel_jul                                          -- fuel naik (penyebab 1 valid)
        AND magg.mtc_aug > magg.mtc_jul                                          -- maintenance naik (penyebab 2 valid)
        AND agg.ot_aug > agg.ot_jul                                              -- overtime naik (penyebab 3 valid)
        AND agg.vol_aug < agg.vol_jul                                            -- volume TURUN (red herring negatif)
       THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status
FROM agg, magg;

-- A06: fuel card fraud -- liters melebihi kapasitas tank, atau transaksi ganda cepat di stasiun berjauhan
WITH over_capacity AS (
  SELECT ft.fuel_id, ft.vehicle_id FROM fleet.fuel_transactions ft

  WHERE ft.liters > v.tank_capacity_liter
),
rapid_refuel AS (
  SELECT ft.fuel_id, ft.vehicle_id,
         LAG(ft.transacted_at) OVER (PARTITION BY ft.vehicle_id ORDER BY ft.transacted_at) AS prev_time,
         LAG(ft.station_location_id) OVER (PARTITION BY ft.vehicle_id ORDER BY ft.transacted_at) AS prev_station

)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM over_capacity) AS n_over_capacity_tx,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT vehicle_id) FROM over_capacity) AS n_vehicles_over_capacity,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM over_capacity) > 100
       THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status

anomalies.description: Delivery akhir pekan SUMUT -> failure rate lebih tinggi (customer_closed)
anomalies.verification_sql:
-- A09: delivery akhir pekan di SUMUT -> failure rate lebih tinggi (dominan customer_closed)
WITH d AS (
  SELECT dl.status, dl.failure_reason, EXTRACT(DOW FROM dl.dispatched_at) IN (0,6) AS is_weekend
  FROM fleet.deliveries dl
  JOIN fleet.orders o ON o.order_id = dl.order_id
  JOIN fleet.locations ld ON ld.location_id = o.destination_location_id
  JOIN fleet.regions r ON r.region_id = ld.region_id
  WHERE r.region_code = 'SUMUT'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG((status IN ('failed','returned'))::int) FILTER (WHERE is_weekend), 4) AS fail_rate_weekend,
  ROUND(AVG((status IN ('failed','returned'))::int) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_weekend), 4) AS fail_rate_weekday,
  ROUND(AVG((status IN ('failed','returned'))::int) FILTER (WHERE is_weekend) /
        NULLIF(AVG((status IN ('failed','returned'))::int) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_weekend),0), 2) AS ratio,
  MODE() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY failure_reason) FILTER (WHERE is_weekend AND status IN ('failed','returned')) AS dominant_reason,
  CASE WHEN AVG((status IN ('failed','returned'))::int) FILTER (WHERE is_weekend) >
            AVG((status IN ('failed','returned'))::int) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_weekend) * 1.5
       THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status
FROM d;

anomalies.description: SLA platinum-FMCG diperketat 36->24 jam sejak 1 Juni 2025
anomalies.verification_sql:
-- A10: SLA platinum-FMCG diperketat 36->24 jam sejak 2025-06-01 -> breach rate naik meski transit stabil
WITH target AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.promised_delivery_at, dl.delivered_at, dl.status,
         EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date)::int >= 6 AS after_june
  FROM fleet.orders o
  JOIN fleet.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN fleet.deliveries dl ON dl.order_id = o.order_id AND dl.status = 'delivered'
  WHERE c.tier = 'platinum' AND c.segment = 'fmcg'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG((delivered_at > promised_delivery_at)::int) FILTER (WHERE NOT after_june), 4) AS breach_rate_before,
  ROUND(AVG((delivered_at > promised_delivery_at)::int) FILTER (WHERE after_june), 4) AS breach_rate_after,
  CASE WHEN AVG((delivered_at > promised_delivery_at)::int) FILTER (WHERE after_june) >
            AVG((delivered_at > promised_delivery_at)::int) FILTER (WHERE NOT after_june) * 1.5
       THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status
FROM target;

anomalies.description: Workshop WS-07: repeat corrective repair kendaraan sama dalam <=14 hari
anomalies.verification_sql:
-- A11: workshop WS-07 -- repeat CORRECTIVE repair kendaraan sama DI WORKSHOP YANG SAMA
-- dalam <=14 hari, dibanding baseline workshop lain (definisi dipersempit
-- supaya bukan sekadar "kepadatan maintenance tahunan" yang membuat baseline
-- ikut tinggi -- ketahuan saat verifikasi pertama, repeat_rate_baseline 79%!)
WITH mtc AS (
  SELECT m.maintenance_id, m.vehicle_id, m.workshop_location_id, m.scheduled_date, l.location_code
  FROM fleet.maintenance m JOIN fleet.locations l ON l.location_id = m.workshop_location_id
  WHERE m.mtc_type = 'corrective'
),
repeat_flag AS (
  SELECT a.maintenance_id, a.location_code,
         EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM mtc b
           WHERE b.vehicle_id = a.vehicle_id AND b.workshop_location_id = a.workshop_location_id
             AND b.maintenance_id <> a.maintenance_id
             AND ABS(b.scheduled_date - a.scheduled_date) <= 14
         ) AS is_repeat
  FROM mtc a
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(is_repeat::int) FILTER (WHERE location_code = 'WS-07'), 4) AS repeat_rate_ws07,
  ROUND(AVG(is_repeat::int) FILTER (WHERE location_code <> 'WS-07'), 4) AS repeat_rate_baseline,
  CASE WHEN AVG(is_repeat::int) FILTER (WHERE location_code = 'WS-07') >
            AVG(is_repeat::int) FILTER (WHERE location_code <> 'WS-07') * 1.8
       THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status
FROM repeat_flag;

anomalies.description: Musim hujan (Des-Feb) koridor Semarang<->Surabaya -> accident event naik

-- A12: musim hujan (Des-Feb) koridor Semarang<->Surabaya -> accident event rate lebih tinggi
WITH d AS (
  SELECT dl.delivery_id, dl.dispatched_at, lo.location_code AS origin_code, r.region_code AS dest_region
  FROM fleet.deliveries dl
  JOIN fleet.orders o ON o.order_id = dl.order_id
  JOIN fleet.locations lo ON lo.location_id = o.origin_location_id
  JOIN fleet.locations ld ON ld.location_id = o.destination_location_id
  JOIN fleet.regions r ON r.region_id = ld.region_id

),
tagged AS (

),
acc AS (
  SELECT delivery_id FROM fleet.vehicle_events WHERE ev_type = 'accident' AND delivery_id IS NOT NULL
)

anomalies.description: 3 rest area menyerap idle_excess panjang -> +47 menit rata2 delivery
anomalies.verification_sql:
-- A13: 3 rest area menyerap idle_excess panjang -> delivery yang melewatinya lebih lama
-- deteksi generik: rest area mana saja yang paling sering direferensikan di metadata idle_excess
WITH idle_ra AS (
  SELECT delivery_id, (metadata->>'rest_area_location_id')::bigint AS ra_id,
         (metadata->>'idle_minutes')::numeric AS idle_minutes
  FROM fleet.vehicle_events
  WHERE ev_type = 'idle_excess' AND metadata ? 'rest_area_location_id'
),
top_ra AS (
  SELECT ra_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM idle_ra GROUP BY ra_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 3
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT dl.delivery_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (dl.delivered_at - dl.dispatched_at))/60.0 AS duration_min,
         (i.ra_id IS NOT NULL) AS passes_rest_area
  FROM fleet.deliveries dl
  LEFT JOIN idle_ra i ON i.delivery_id = dl.delivery_id AND i.ra_id IN (SELECT ra_id FROM top_ra)
  WHERE dl.status = 'delivered' AND dl.delivered_at > dl.dispatched_at
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ra_id) FROM top_ra) AS n_rest_area_detected,
  ROUND(AVG((SELECT idle_minutes FROM idle_ra i2 WHERE i2.delivery_id = f.delivery_id LIMIT 1))
        FILTER (WHERE passes_rest_area), 1) AS avg_idle_minutes_flagged,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE passes_rest_area) AS n_flagged_deliveries,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ra_id) FROM top_ra) = 3
       AND (SELECT AVG(idle_minutes) FROM idle_ra) BETWEEN 30 AND 65
       THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status
FROM flagged f;

anomalies.description: Kendaraan >8 harsh_braking/1000km -> biaya maintenance/km naik
anomalies.verification_sql:
-- A14: kendaraan >8 harsh_braking/1000km -> maintenance cost/km lebih tinggi
WITH hb AS (
  SELECT vehicle_id, COUNT(*) AS n_hb FROM fleet.vehicle_events WHERE ev_type = 'harsh_braking' GROUP BY vehicle_id
),
rate AS (
  SELECT v.vehicle_id, v.odometer_km, COALESCE(hb.n_hb,0) / NULLIF(v.odometer_km/1000.0,0) AS hb_per_1000km
  FROM fleet.vehicles v LEFT JOIN hb ON hb.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id
),
grp AS (
  SELECT r.vehicle_id, (r.hb_per_1000km > 8) AS is_high FROM rate r
),
mtc AS (
  SELECT m.vehicle_id, SUM(m.cost_idr) AS total_cost, MAX(v.odometer_km) AS odo
  FROM fleet.maintenance m JOIN fleet.vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id = m.vehicle_id
  GROUP BY m.vehicle_id
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_high) AS n_high_hb_vehicles,
  ROUND(SUM(mtc.total_cost) FILTER (WHERE is_high) / NULLIF(SUM(mtc.odo) FILTER (WHERE is_high),0), 2) AS cost_per_km_high,
  ROUND(SUM(mtc.total_cost) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_high) / NULLIF(SUM(mtc.odo) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_high),0), 2) AS cost_per_km_normal,
  CASE WHEN SUM(mtc.total_cost) FILTER (WHERE is_high) / NULLIF(SUM(mtc.odo) FILTER (WHERE is_high),0) >
            SUM(mtc.total_cost) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_high) / NULLIF(SUM(mtc.odo) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_high),0) * 1.25
       THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status
FROM grp g JOIN mtc ON mtc.vehicle_id = g.vehicle_id;

anomalies.description: Lonjakan order tanggal kembar (9/9,10/10,11/11,12/12) segment ecommerce
anomalies.verification_sql:
-- A15: lonjakan order tanggal kembar (9/9,10/10,11/11,12/12) segment ecommerce
WITH twin AS (
  SELECT order_date::date AS d, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM fleet.orders
  WHERE order_date::date IN ('2025-09-09','2025-10-10','2025-11-11','2025-12-12')
  GROUP BY order_date::date
),
normal AS (
  SELECT AVG(daily_n) AS avg_daily FROM (
    SELECT order_date::date AS d, COUNT(*) AS daily_n FROM fleet.orders

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(twin.n),0) AS avg_twin_date_volume,
  ROUND(normal.avg_daily,0) AS avg_normal_daily_volume,

anomalies.description: 2 kendaraan delivery selama window maintenance panjang overlap
anomalies.verification_sql:
-- A16: kendaraan tercatat delivery selama window maintenance yang berlangsung lama (>5 hari)
-- -- deteksi generik lewat overlap tanggal antara deliveries & maintenance per kendaraan,
-- tanpa bergantung pada anotasi manapun.
WITH mtc AS (
  SELECT vehicle_id, scheduled_date, COALESCE(performed_date, scheduled_date) AS end_date,
         COALESCE(performed_date, scheduled_date) - scheduled_date AS span_days
  FROM fleet.maintenance
  WHERE COALESCE(performed_date, scheduled_date) - scheduled_date > 5   -- window maintenance panjang, bukan servis rutin sehari
),
overlap AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dl.delivery_id, dl.vehicle_id
  FROM fleet.deliveries dl
  JOIN mtc ON mtc.vehicle_id = dl.vehicle_id
  WHERE dl.dispatched_at::date BETWEEN mtc.scheduled_date AND mtc.end_date
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT vehicle_id) AS n_vehicles_affected,
  COUNT(*) AS n_deliveries_overlapping,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT vehicle_id) >= 2 AND COUNT(*) >= 40 THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status
FROM overlap;

       CASE WHEN region_code IN ('SULSEL','SUMUT','SUMSEL','BALI') THEN 'higher-cost region (by design)' ELSE 'baseline' END AS note

anomalies.description: Driver overwork (>11 jam/hari) -> insiden hari berikutnya naik
anomalies.verification_sql:
-- A18: driver dengan total jam kerja >11 jam sehari -> insiden hari berikutnya naik
WITH d AS (
  SELECT delivery_id, driver_id, vehicle_id, dispatched_at::date AS work_date,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (arrived_at - dispatched_at))/3600.0 AS duration_h
  FROM fleet.deliveries WHERE arrived_at IS NOT NULL AND arrived_at > dispatched_at
),
daily AS (
  SELECT driver_id, work_date, SUM(duration_h) AS total_h FROM d GROUP BY driver_id, work_date
),
overwork AS (
  SELECT driver_id, work_date FROM daily WHERE total_h > 11
),
nextday AS (
  SELECT d.delivery_id, TRUE AS is_nextday
  FROM d JOIN overwork o ON o.driver_id = d.driver_id AND o.work_date = d.work_date - INTERVAL '1 day'
),
incident AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT delivery_id FROM fleet.vehicle_events
  WHERE ev_type IN ('harsh_braking','overspeed','accident') AND delivery_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM overwork) AS n_overwork_driver_days,
  COUNT(*) AS n_nextday_deliveries,
  ROUND(AVG((d.delivery_id IN (SELECT delivery_id FROM incident))::int) FILTER (WHERE nd.is_nextday), 4) AS incident_rate_nextday,
  ROUND(AVG((d.delivery_id IN (SELECT delivery_id FROM incident))::int) FILTER (WHERE nd.is_nextday IS NULL), 4) AS incident_rate_baseline,
  CASE WHEN AVG((d.delivery_id IN (SELECT delivery_id FROM incident))::int) FILTER (WHERE nd.is_nextday) >
            AVG((d.delivery_id IN (SELECT delivery_id FROM incident))::int) FILTER (WHERE nd.is_nextday IS NULL) * 2.0
       THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status
FROM d LEFT JOIN nextday nd ON nd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id;

anomalies.description: Tronton load factor rendah (~41%); CDE overload >100% pada ~8% delivery
anomalies.verification_sql:
-- A20: tronton load factor rendah (~41%), CDE overload >100% kapasitas pada ~8.1% delivery
WITH dv AS (
  SELECT dl.delivery_id, vm.v_class, vm.capacity_kg, o.weight_kg,
         o.weight_kg / NULLIF(vm.capacity_kg,0) AS load_factor
  FROM fleet.deliveries dl
  JOIN fleet.orders o ON o.order_id = dl.order_id
  JOIN fleet.vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id = dl.vehicle_id
  JOIN fleet.vehicle_models vm ON vm.model_id = v.model_id
  WHERE o.weight_kg > 0
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(load_factor) FILTER (WHERE v_class='tronton'), 3) AS tronton_avg_load_factor,
  ROUND(AVG((load_factor > 1.0)::int) FILTER (WHERE v_class='cde') * 100, 1) AS cde_overload_pct,
  CASE WHEN AVG(load_factor) FILTER (WHERE v_class='tronton') BETWEEN 0.30 AND 0.55
        AND AVG((load_factor > 1.0)::int) FILTER (WHERE v_class='cde') BETWEEN 0.04 AND 0.14
       THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status
FROM dv;

anomalies.description: Delivery malam: transit -12% (tod_factor), fuel cost +9% (overspeed)
anomalies.verification_sql:
-- A22: delivery malam (22:00-04:00): transit -12% (tod_factor bawaan) & fuel cost +9% (overspeed)
WITH d AS (
  SELECT dl.delivery_id, dl.fuel_cost_idr, dl.actual_distance_km,
         EXTRACT(HOUR FROM dl.dispatched_at) AS h,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (dl.delivered_at - dl.dispatched_at))/3600.0 AS transit_h
  FROM fleet.deliveries dl WHERE dl.status='delivered' AND dl.delivered_at > dl.dispatched_at
),
tagged AS (
  SELECT *, (h >= 22 OR h <= 4) AS is_night FROM d
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(fuel_cost_idr / NULLIF(actual_distance_km,0)) FILTER (WHERE is_night), 1) AS fuel_per_km_night,
  ROUND(AVG(fuel_cost_idr / NULLIF(actual_distance_km,0)) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_night), 1) AS fuel_per_km_day,
  ROUND(AVG(fuel_cost_idr / NULLIF(actual_distance_km,0)) FILTER (WHERE is_night) /
        NULLIF(AVG(fuel_cost_idr / NULLIF(actual_distance_km,0)) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_night),0), 3) AS fuel_ratio,
  ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fleet.vehicle_events WHERE ev_type='overspeed'
         AND delivery_id IN (SELECT delivery_id FROM tagged WHERE is_night))::numeric /
        NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tagged WHERE is_night),0), 3) AS overspeed_rate_night,
  CASE WHEN AVG(fuel_cost_idr / NULLIF(actual_distance_km,0)) FILTER (WHERE is_night) >
            AVG(fuel_cost_idr / NULLIF(actual_distance_km,0)) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_night) * 1.03
       THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status
FROM tagged;

anomalies.description: Kendaraan umur >7 tahun: biaya maintenance/km ~2.1x vs <3 tahun
anomalies.verification_sql:
-- A26: kendaraan umur >7 tahun -- biaya maintenance/km (km DIKENDARAI TAHUN 2025,
-- bukan odometer seumur hidup) lebih tinggi vs kendaraan umur <3 tahun.
-- Catatan: versi sebelumnya membagi cost tahun ini dengan odometer SEUMUR HIDUP
-- (vehicles.odometer_km) -- untuk kendaraan tua itu angka besar (sudah bertahun-tahun
-- dipakai), untuk kendaraan muda angka kecil (baru dibeli), sehingga rasionya
-- selalu terbalik terlepas dari cost aktual. Km tahun 2025 diestimasi dari
-- rentang odometer_km di fuel_transactions (yang sekarang kumulatif per
-- kendaraan & fisik konsisten, lihat facts.py gen_fuel_transactions).
WITH km_2025 AS (
  SELECT vehicle_id, MAX(odometer_km) - MIN(odometer_km) AS km_driven_2025
  FROM fleet.fuel_transactions GROUP BY vehicle_id
),
veh AS (
  SELECT vehicle_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE('2025-12-31'::date, acquisition_date)) AS age_years
  FROM fleet.vehicles
),
vehicle_cost AS (
  SELECT vehicle_id, SUM(cost_idr) AS total_cost FROM fleet.maintenance GROUP BY vehicle_id
),
per_vehicle AS (
  SELECT veh.vehicle_id, veh.age_years, vc.total_cost / NULLIF(k.km_driven_2025,0) AS cost_per_km
  FROM veh
  JOIN vehicle_cost vc ON vc.vehicle_id = veh.vehicle_id
  JOIN km_2025 k ON k.vehicle_id = veh.vehicle_id
  WHERE k.km_driven_2025 > 500   -- buang kendaraan dengan data fuel terlalu sedikit utk estimasi wajar
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(cost_per_km) FILTER (WHERE age_years > 7), 2) AS cost_per_km_old,
  ROUND(AVG(cost_per_km) FILTER (WHERE age_years < 3), 2) AS cost_per_km_young,
  ROUND(AVG(cost_per_km) FILTER (WHERE age_years > 7) / NULLIF(AVG(cost_per_km) FILTER (WHERE age_years < 3),0), 2) AS ratio,
  CASE WHEN AVG(cost_per_km) FILTER (WHERE age_years > 7) >
            AVG(cost_per_km) FILTER (WHERE age_years < 3) * 1.5
       THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS status
FROM per_vehicle;
